svg.title: The office floor today and in the two building phases
svg.desc: Plan with 6 areas on a grid of 13 × 6 units, seen at an angle: Open office (room, 6 × 4, Existing, with desk, desk, desk, desk, desk and desk); Meeting room (room, 4 × 3, Existing, with table); Kitchen (room, 4 × 3, Phase 1, with table and plant); Server room (room, 3 × 2, Phase 1, with shelf and shelf); Library (room, 3 × 2, Phase 2, with shelf and sofa); Terrace (outdoor, 3 × 6, Phase 2). Phases: Existing: Open office and Meeting room; Phase 1: Kitchen and Server room; Phase 2: Library and Terrace.
svg.text: The office floor today and in the two building phases
